scope: Canopy form only on already-existing signed hedgerow placements. Never approve new stems, geometry outside verified dated outline, ground/collision, species or modern height.
comparison: Same ordinary unforced 4x 1200x760 Chase frame, old default, old neutral prepared, fenced volume, restored stock.
lastVisibleSupport: Independent same-depth final RGB marker for old and new role, plus clip-space support of actual submitted buffers (do not count summed quads as pixels), both nonvacuous.
artStop: At 1x reject repeated solid balls, unnatural artificial light seams, closed corridors opened by swaps, artificial filling of signed corridor gaps, or disruption of actual branch/canopy distribution. Huge optical colour changes alone fail.
evidenceLabel: This is an acceptance prelock for future live rendering. Technical results or positive roots alone do not approve art. Not a current scenery deployment.
